PANJAB UNIVERSITY
DR. HARVANSH SINGH JUDGE INSTITUTE OF DENTAL SCIENCES &
HOSPITAL, SECTOR-25, CHANDIGARH
Ph: 0172-2534686, 87, 89. E-mail: directordental@pu.ac.in
No. D-HSJ/24/1987 Dated 24.09.2024
WALK IN INTERVIEW
Applications on plain paper giving complete particulars/qualification/experience etc.
are invited for the appointment of one post of Operation Theatre Assistant at Dr.
Harvansh Singh Judge Institute of Dental Sciences & Hospital, Sector-25, Chandigarh
purely on contract basis (through Walk-in-Interview) in the Basic Pay (5910 + GP (2000) in
the Level 3 in central pay matrix initially for the period of one year by giving one day break
after every 89 days & further extendable for another period as per the requirements of the
Institute or till the post is filled in through regular selection whichever is earlier.
Qualifications:
(i) Should have passed the Senior Secondary Part-II Examination with Science from
a recognized University or Institution; and
(ii) Should possess a Diploma in Operation Theatre Technique from a recognized
University or Institution.
Age Limit:Upper age limit 37 years of age as on 30/09/2024.
The walk-in-interview of the candidates shall be held on 08.10.2024 (Tuesday). The
candidates should report from 9.30 a.m. onwards in Committee Room of the Dental Institute
(the candidate must reach the office latest by 11.00 a.m.). No candidate will be entertained
afterwards). The candidate must bring along with them the original certificates/testimonials
at the time of interview for verification. Candidate should bring self attested photocopies of
all documents (Academic/Experience or any other essential documents as per rules of the
governing body/Council), NOC from current employer, experience certificate and two recent
passport size photographs.
No separate letter for interview shall be issued. No TA/DA for attending the interview will
be paid.
Sd/-
Principal-cum-Professor
Issued for display on Notice Board to: PA to Registrar, P.U., Heads of Teaching
Depts./Instts., P.U., M.S. PGI, Director Principal Medical College & Hospital, Sector-32,
Chandigarh. Director, GMSH, Sector-16, Chandigarh and Director Computer Science, P.U.
for uploading the notice on the University Website for information to the prospective
candidates/public.
